**Problem to solve**
What farmer, admin, official or insurer problem does this solve? Which phase/roadmap item
does it relate to, if any?

**Proposed solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches or workarounds you have thought about.

**Farmer-first checklist** (if user-facing)

- [ ] Works on low-end Android phones and slow networks
- [ ] Touch targets are at least 48px
- [ ] Icon + text, never colour alone to convey meaning
- [ ] All strings go through i18n (next-intl)
- [ ] Measurements stored in metres; display respects m/ft preference

**Additional context**
Any other context, screenshots or sketches.
